name: John T. Wen
title: Russell Sage Professor of Engineering
department: Electrical, Computer, and Systems Engineering; joint Mechanical, Aerospace, and Nuclear Engineering
fitReason: Physical AI through learned nonlinear process models embedded in closed-loop industrial robot control; more manufacturing-specific than generalist manipulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: May 2026 primary preprint executes learned-model geometry control during actual stainless-steel wire-arc additive manufacturing. A Yaskawa MA2010 welding robot, FujiCam line scanner, D500B trunnion table and Fronius TPS500i power source are coordinated by a PC. Trained RNN predictions and online model adaptation adjust torch speed and wire feed at 10 Hz. RNN/LSTM/GRU/NARX comparison includes offline model evaluation; the reported RNN control is physical deposition. It learns process dynamics and adjusts robot/process commands, not an end-to-end RL manipulation policy.
